title: Potato Optimized By Nongmoon🇹🇭
description: Stop playing a slideshow and start playing a game. Potato Optimized cuts the fluff and boosts the frames so even the humblest rigs can keep up with the action.
body:
Potato Optimized is a high-performance modpack designed to push the limits of the Fabric engine. Instead of just focusing on graphics, this pack addresses every major bottleneck—from rendering and world generation to memory management and networking. 🚀 Key Features
Click to expand: Rendering & Graphics Mod Description Sodium Complete rendering engine replacement for massive FPS gains. Iris High-performance shader support with optimized overhead. EntityCulling Prevents the GPU from rendering mobs you can't see. ImmediatelyFast Speeds up UI and particle rendering for a snappier feel. Cull Leaves Increases performance by not rendering hidden leaf faces.
Click to expand: Game Logic & World Gen Lithium: Optimizes game physics and AI without changing vanilla behavior. CCME: Multi-threads chunk management to eliminate world-loading stutters. Noisium: Faster world generation calculations. ScalableLux: A high-performance lighting engine replacement. ServerCore: Optimizes server-side performance for a smoother experience.
Click to expand: System & Memory FerriteCore & ModernFix: Drastically reduces RAM usage and fixes memory leaks. ThreadTweak: Optimizes CPU core usage to prevent micro-stutters. Krypton: Optimizes the network stack to reduce jitter on servers. Let Me Despawn: Prevents lag caused by entities that refuse to disappear.
🛠️ Technical Details Feature Powered By Engine Fabric API Configuration Cloth Config, YACL, MidnightLib UI Mod Menu, Almanac Networking Krypton, Placeholder API
